savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Each advisory committee listed below is continued until September 30, 2003.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Continues fourteen named advisory committees; the American Heritage Rivers Initiative Advisory Committee is not among them.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 5: 'This order shall be effective September 30, 2001.' The revocations in sec. 3 are therefore effective 2001-09-30 (signed September 28, 2001; printed 66 FR 50291-50292, October 3, 2001).

targets_in_batch_03.EO:13080: sec. 3(b) ('Executive Order 13080, establishing the American Heritage Rivers Initiative Advisory Committee'), under the lead-in 'which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked'

conclusion: EO 13225 (signed 2001-09-28, 66 FR 50291, PDF pages 1-2, read once in full) continues fourteen advisory committees to 2003-09-30 (sec. 1), assigns FACA functions (sec. 2), revokes five orders or sections that 'established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed' (sec. 3, including EO 13080 in 3(b)), supersedes secs. 1-4 of EO 13138 (sec. 4) and is effective 2001-09-30 (sec. 5). No savings, transfer or exception provision. The recital of sec. 3 says the committees had already terminated, so the revocation of EO 13080 is a clean-up after the Committee's own two-year term, not its first end.
